$comment: Hand corrections applied on top of Wikidata by scripts/seed-fleet.mjs, keyed by IMO.
Each entry needs an imo, a reason, a source URL where possible, and exactly one action:
set:     patch fields on a sourced ship, e.g. { "status": "retired" }
add:     a ship Wikidata lacks entirely (needs at least a name)
exclude: true to drop a false positive (a ferry, a yacht, a duplicate)
Prefer fixing Wikidata too; the refresh PR lists overrides that become stale.
Editable fields: see OVERRIDABLE_FIELDS in scripts/fleet-registry-build.mjs.

overrides.reason: Celebrity Xcel is the fifth Edge-class ship, but its Wikidata item has no vessel-class statement, so it is missing from the Edge class's sister-ship index.
Wikidata lists both Royal Caribbean International and Azamara as undated current operators; the ship sails for Azamara (its sister Azamara Pursuit is already dated correctly).
Wikidata's only operator statements are historic US Coast Guard / US Navy service with no end dates; the vessel now sails for Sea Cloud Cruises.
